title: A failed provision's fleet reason is trimmed of trailing dots and white space in linear time (CodeQL alert of release #395, round 3)
steps: S1: From the repository root run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/site/tracy-site-build-core/test/linear-readers.test.mjs packages/site/tracy-site-build-core/test/host-words.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines and the result of each test named in run.tests.
expect: Every named test is 'ok': withoutTrailingDotsAndSpace gives what `replace(/[.\s]+$/, '')` gave on fixed reasons (trailing dots, spaces, tabs, newlines, a no-break space, an inner dot kept) and trims a run of tabs in linear time; provisionTodos still builds the task list in every language.

selectors.readers: withoutTrailingDotsAndSpace (tracy-site-build-core src/host/design-systems-switch.mjs), used by provisionTodos (src/host/host.ts) and embedded in the emdash, joomla and wordpress lib/index.js

evidence: CodeQL check of the release PR #395 after #407: polynomial regular expression on library input at packages/site/tracy-site-build-core/src/host/host.ts:676 (`detail.replace(/[.\s]+$/, '')`), slow on many repetitions of a tab. Measured: the old pattern took 665 ms on 30 000 tabs followed by `x`; with the old pattern put back in the helper, the linear test took 29.9 s at 200 000 and failed.
fence: Mechanism only: the trim's answers and its growth in time. Not covered: the CodeQL run itself (no CodeQL CLI on the machine).

tests: parseRoute reads the door as before
